Evaporative Cooler Covers

Evaporative cooler covers shield your unit during the off-season and between cooling cycles, when accumulated dust, falling debris, and prolonged UV exposure cause most premature wear. A properly fitted cover keeps pads, motor, and louvers protected so the unit starts cleanly next season.

Evaporative coolers need large intake panels to pull air through wet pads in summer. When the unit is off, those same openings become a straight path for cold outdoor air, rain, dust, and nesting pests. A tarp thrown over the top usually leaves side gaps — a fitted cover wraps the outside cabinet and closes every intake path.
